title: Tests: RecipeFile, RecipeDiscovery, RecipesFolderStore, AppRoot gating
description: Add unit tests using Swift Testing (import Testing, @Test, #expect — not XCTest). RecipeFileTests: display-name derivation strips .cook case-insensitively (Creamy Chicken Alfredo.cook → Creamy Chicken Alfredo; Pasta.COOK → Pasta). RecipeDiscoveryTests: against a temporary fixture directory containing 2 subdirectories with mixed .cook/non-.cook files, 1 top-level .cook file, 1 hidden dotfolder, 1 non-.cook file — asserts section count, names, row counts, alphabetical sort, (no folder) last, hidden entries skipped. RecipesFolderStoreTests: bookmark round-trip resolves to same directory after re-instantiation; stale bookmark clears both UserDefaults keys and yields nil resolvedFolderURL. AppRoot tests: nil store → FolderSetupView visible, tab bar absent; configured store → tab bar visible, FolderSetupView absent. Run xcodebuild test to confirm all pass.
acceptance_criteria: All test files compile with Swift Testing (import Testing, @Test, #expect).
RecipeDiscoveryTests: correct section count, names, row counts, sort order, (no folder) last, hidden skipped, non-.cook excluded.
RecipesFolderStoreTests: round-trip resolves to same directory after re-init.
RecipesFolderStoreTests: stale bookmark clears UserDefaults and yields nil resolvedFolderURL.
AppRoot test: nil state → FolderSetupView present, tab bar absent.
AppRoot test: configured state → tab bar present, FolderSetupView absent.
xcodebuild test exits with no failures.
